info.name: Dolphin API
info.description: Dolphin School Management Platform - REST API v1. Generated from the repository source (controllers, DTOs, @PreAuthorize, SecurityConfig). Public endpoints: POST /api/v1/auth/login, /refresh, /logout and POST /api/v1/guardian-invitations/accept. Every other request requires 'Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}' (collection-level bearer auth). Create requests must run before requests that consume the returned id. See docs/testing/API_TESTING.md for prerequisites, ordering and cURL equivalents.

request.description: Public. Returns LoginResponse {accessToken, tokenType, expiresInSeconds, refreshToken, refreshExpiresInSeconds, userId, username}. Saves accessToken/refreshToken/userId into collection AND environment variables.
Public. Rotates the refresh token and returns a new LoginResponse. The previous refresh token is revoked (reuse revokes the whole session family). Overwrites accessToken/refreshToken.
Public. Revokes the refresh session family. Returns 204 No Content. Silently succeeds for unknown tokens.

Requires authentication (any logged-in user). Changes the caller's own password and revokes all of that user's refresh sessions. WARNING: running this invalidates adminPassword in this environment - update it afterwards or skip this request.
Permission ROLE_CREATE. Returns 201 RoleResponse {id, code, name, description, active}. Captures roleId.

request.description: Permission PERMISSION_READ. Returns 200 PermissionResponse.
Permission ROLE_PERMISSION_ASSIGN. Returns 204 No Content on success; 409 if already granted.
Permission USER_CREATE. Returns 201 UserResponse {id, username, email, firstName, lastName, active}. Captures userAccountId (reusable for student account linking).
Permission USER_READ. Returns 200 UserResponse.
Permission USER_UPDATE. Returns 200 UserResponse.
Permission USER_ROLE_ASSIGN. Returns 204 No Content.

Permission USER_SCOPE_ASSIGN. scopeType is one of ENTERPRISE|REGION|CLUSTER|INSTITUTION|CAMPUS. Returns 201 OrganizationScopeResponse {id, userId, scopeType, scopeId}. Captures scopeId. Requires institutionId to exist.

Permission USER_DEACTIVATE. Returns 200 UserResponse with active=false and revokes the user's refresh sessions. Idempotent. WARNING: deactivating the account used for login would break later requests.
Permission ENTERPRISE_CREATE. No parent. Returns 201 EnterpriseResponse {id, code, name, active}. Captures enterpriseId.
Permission ENTERPRISE_READ (scope: enterprise). Returns 200 EnterpriseResponse.
Permission REGION_CREATE (scope over parent enterprise). Returns 201 RegionResponse {id, enterpriseId, code, name, active}. Captures regionId.
Permission REGION_READ. Returns 200 RegionResponse.
Permission REGION_READ. Returns 200 List<RegionResponse>.
Permission CLUSTER_CREATE (scope over parent region). Returns 201 ClusterResponse. Captures clusterId.
Permission CLUSTER_READ. Returns 200 ClusterResponse.
Permission CLUSTER_READ. Returns 200 List<ClusterResponse>.

Permission INSTITUTION_CREATE (scope over parent cluster). institutionType is a free string (<=50). Returns 201 InstitutionResponse {id, clusterId, code, name, institutionType, active}. Captures institutionId.
Permission INSTITUTION_READ. Returns 200 InstitutionResponse.
Permission CAMPUS_CREATE (scope over parent institution). Returns 201 CampusResponse {id, institutionId, code, name, address, active}. Captures campusId.
Permission CAMPUS_READ. Returns 200 CampusResponse.
Permission STUDENT_CREATE (institution/campus scope). Returns 201 StudentResponse {id, institutionId, campusId, admissionNumber, firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth, active}. Captures studentId.
Permission STUDENT_READ. Returns 200 StudentResponse; 404 if absent/inactive.
Permission STUDENT_READ. Returns 200 Page<StudentResponse>. institutionId required; campusId/search/page/size/sort optional (size capped at 100).
Permission STUDENT_UPDATE. Returns 200 StudentResponse; 409 on duplicate admission number or stale version.

Permission STUDENT_ACCOUNT_LINK (institution scope). Links an existing user account to the student and grants the STUDENT role + institution scope. Returns 201 StudentAccountLinkResponse {id, studentId, userAccountId, createdAt}. Captures studentAccountLinkId.
Permission STUDENT_DEACTIVATE. Returns 200 StudentResponse with active=false. WARNING: deactivated students disappear from reads/searches and cannot be updated.

Permission STAFF_CREATE (institution scope). Creates a staff member + assignment. staffType: TEACHER|PRINCIPAL|ADMINISTRATOR|LIBRARIAN|COUNSELOR|SUPPORT. Returns 201 StaffAssignmentResponse. Captures staffMemberId and staffAssignmentId.
Permission STAFF_READ. status: ACTIVE|ON_LEAVE|INACTIVE|TERMINATED (default ACTIVE). Returns 200 Page<StaffAssignmentResponse>.
Permission STAFF_UPDATE. Terminal states INACTIVE/TERMINATED cannot be reactivated here. Returns 200 StaffAssignmentResponse.
Permission GUARDIAN_CREATE (institution scope). Returns 201 GuardianResponse {id, institutionId, firstName, lastName, email, phone, active}. Captures guardianId.
Permission GUARDIAN_READ. Returns 200 GuardianResponse.
Permission GUARDIAN_UPDATE. Returns 200 GuardianResponse.
Permission STUDENT_GUARDIAN_LINK. Returns 201 StudentGuardianResponse {guardianId, firstName, lastName, email, phone, relationshipType, primaryContact, pickupAuthorized}.
Permission GUARDIAN_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentGuardianResponse>.
Permission GUARDIAN_INVITE. Returns 201 GuardianInvitationResponse {invitationId, token, email, expiresAt}. The raw token is returned ONCE. Captures invitationToken.
PUBLIC. token + password (8..72). Creates a GUARDIAN user account. Returns 201 GuardianAccountAcceptedResponse {userId, username, message}. No token is issued; log in afterwards.
Permission STUDENT_GUARDIAN_UNLINK. Returns 204 No Content.
Permission GUARDIAN_DEACTIVATE. Returns 200 GuardianResponse with active=false and deactivates active student links.
Permission ACADEMIC_YEAR_CREATE. Returns 201 with a BARE UUID string. Captures academicYearId.
Permission ACADEMIC_YEAR_READ. Returns 200 List<AcademicYearResponse> {id, institutionId, name, startDate, endDate, status}.
Permission ACADEMIC_YEAR_ACTIVATE. PLANNED -> ACTIVE. Returns 200 bare UUID. At most one ACTIVE year per institution.
Permission CLASS_CREATE. Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures schoolClassId.
Permission CLASS_READ. Returns 200 List<SchoolClassResponse>.
Permission SECTION_CREATE. Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures sectionId.
Permission SECTION_READ. Returns 200 List<ClassSectionResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_ENROLL. Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures enrollmentId. The year must be ACTIVE and the student & section in the same institution.
Permission ENROLLMENT_READ. Returns 200 Page<StudentEnrollmentResponse>. size > 100 returns 422.
Permission ENROLLMENT_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentEnrollmentResponse>.
Permission ENROLLMENT_COMPLETE. ACTIVE -> COMPLETED. Returns 200 bare UUID. WARNING: run only if this enrollment should end.

Permission STUDENT_TRANSFER. Returns 200 bare UUID (new enrollment). targetSectionId MUST be a different section in the same institution; using the same sectionId will fail with 422. Set a valid target section id first.
Permission ENROLLMENT_WITHDRAW. ACTIVE -> WITHDRAWN. Returns 200 bare UUID.
Permission ACADEMIC_YEAR_CLOSE. ACTIVE -> CLOSED. Fails with 422 while an active enrollment exists. Run last.
Permission SUBJECT_CREATE. Returns 201 AcademicSubjectResponse {id, institutionId, code, name, description, active}. Captures subjectId.
Permission SUBJECT_READ. Returns 200 List<AcademicSubjectResponse>.

Permission TEACHER_SUBJECT_ASSIGN. Returns 201 TeacherSubjectAssignmentResponse {id, staffAssignmentId, staffMemberId, teacherName, employeeNumber, subjectId, subjectCode, subjectName, startDate, endDate, active}. Captures teacherSubjectAssignmentId.
Permission TEACHER_SUBJECT_READ. Returns 200 List<TeacherSubjectAssignmentResponse>.
Permission TEACHER_SUBJECT_ASSIGN. endDate is an ISO date query param. Returns 200 TeacherSubjectAssignmentResponse with active=false.
Permission ATTENDANCE_MARK. status: PRESENT|ABSENT|LATE|EXCUSED. 1..500 records. Returns 200 List<AttendanceResponse>. Captures attendanceId from the first record.
Permission ATTENDANCE_READ. Returns 200 Page<AttendanceResponse>. Optional studentId filter.
Permission ATTENDANCE_UPDATE. Returns 200 AttendanceResponse; writes an audit row; 409 on stale version.
Permission ATTENDANCE_AUDIT_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceAuditResponse>.

Permission ATTENDANCE_READ. Returns 200 AttendanceSummaryResponse {institutionId, campusId, attendanceDate, presentCount, absentCount, lateCount, excusedCount, totalRecorded, attendanceEligibleCount, attendancePercentage}.
Permission ATTENDANCE_READ. Returns 200 List<DailyAttendanceTrendResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonAttendanceRosterItemResponse>. Requires a generated lesson occurrence.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonAttendanceResponse>.

Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_MARK. 1..200 records. Returns 200 List<LessonAttendanceResponse> {id, occurrenceId, studentId, studentName, lessonDate, status, markedByUserId, markedAt, remarks, version}. Captures lessonAttendanceRecordId. Lesson must be today/past and not cancelled.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_UPDATE. Returns 200 LessonAttendanceResponse; writes an audit row.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonAttendanceAuditResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentAttendanceAnalyticsResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceGroupAnalyticsResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceGroupAnalyticsResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_LESSON_READ. threshold defaults to 75.00. Returns 200 List<StudentAttendanceAnalyticsResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_ALERT_GENERATE. thresholdPercent 0.00..100.00. Returns 200 with a bare integer (number of alerts generated) and enqueues notifications.
Permission ATTENDANCE_ALERT_READ. Optional status OPEN|ACKNOWLEDGED|RESOLVED. Returns 200 Page<AttendanceAlertAdminResponse>. Captures alertId from the first row if present.
Permission ATTENDANCE_ALERT_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceAlertAuditResponse>.
Permission ATTENDANCE_ALERT_RESOLVE. Only OPEN alerts can be acknowledged. Returns 200 {alertId, status:'ACKNOWLEDGED', message}.
Permission ATTENDANCE_ALERT_RESOLVE. Returns 200 {alertId, status:'RESOLVED', message}.
Permission ASSESSMENT_CREATE. maxMarks >= 0.01. Returns 201 AssessmentResponse {id, institutionId, sectionId, name, subjectName, assessmentDate, maxMarks, active}. Captures assessmentId.
Permission MARKS_READ. Returns 200 Page<AssessmentResponse>.
Permission MARKS_RECORD. 1..500 records. marksObtained cannot exceed maxMarks (422). Returns 200 List<StudentMarkResponse>. Captures markId.
Permission MARKS_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentMarkResponse>.
Permission MARKS_UPDATE. version is required (optimistic lock); stale version -> 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION. Returns 200 StudentMarkResponse.
Permission MARKS_AUDIT_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentMarkAuditResponse>.
Permission MARKS_READ. Returns 200 StudentReportCardResponse (staff, institution scope).
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Self-scoped; resolves the student from the account link. Returns 200 StudentReportCardResponse.
Permission ROOM_CREATE. Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures roomId.
Permission ROOM_READ. Returns 200 List<SchoolRoomResponse>.
Permission TIMETABLE_SLOT_CREATE. dayOfWeek 1..7 (Mon..Sun). Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures slotId.
Permission TIMETABLE_SLOT_READ. Returns 200 List<TimetableSlotResponse>.
Permission TIMETABLE_READ. Returns 200 List<ScheduledLessonResponse>.
Permission TEACHER_TIMETABLE_READ. Returns 200 List<ScheduledLessonResponse>.
Permission TIMETABLE_LESSON_CREATE. Returns 201 bare UUID. Captures lessonId.
Permission TIMETABLE_LESSON_UPDATE. Returns 200 bare UUID.
Permission TIMETABLE_LESSON_CREATE. Range <= 366 days. Returns 201 with a bare integer (occurrences created). Teacher-on-approved-leave days are skipped.
Permission TIMETABLE_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonOccurrenceResponse>. Captures occurrenceId from the first row (needed by lesson-attendance and substitute requests).
Permission SUBSTITUTE_ASSIGN. Returns 200 SubstituteAssignmentResponse; writes an audit row.
Permission TIMETABLE_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonOccurrenceResponse> needing coverage.
Permission TIMETABLE_READ. Returns 200 List<LessonSubstituteAuditResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Self-scoped. Returns 200 List<ScheduledLessonResponse>.
Permission TIMETABLE_LESSON_CANCEL. Returns 200 bare UUID. Run after occurrence generation to avoid suppressing generation.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_CREATE. dueAt is an OffsetDateTime. Returns 201 AssignmentResponse (status DRAFT). Captures assignmentId.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_READ. Returns 200 AssignmentResponse (includes version).
Permission ASSIGNMENT_READ. status: DRAFT|PUBLISHED. Returns 200 Page<AssignmentResponse>.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_UPDATE. Only DRAFT assignments. version required. Returns 200 AssignmentResponse.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_PUBLISH. DRAFT -> PUBLISHED (one-way). Returns 200 AssignmentResponse.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_READ. Returns 200 Page<AssignmentSubmissionResponse>. Captures submissionId from the first row if present (a student must submit first).
Permission ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_GRADE. marksObtained <= maxMarks (422 otherwise). Returns 200 AssignmentSubmissionResponse (status GRADED).
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 Page<AssignmentResponse> for the student's active sections.
Permission ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_CREATE. Student must be enrolled in the assignment's section and the assignment must be PUBLISHED. Returns 201 (or 200 when updating an existing submission).
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 AssignmentSubmissionResponse or 404 if none.

Permission STAFF_LEAVE_CREATE. leaveTypeId must be an existing leave_type id (seeded codes ANNUAL/SICK/PERSONAL/UNPAID - ids are random UUIDs and are NOT exposed by any API). Returns 201 StaffLeaveResponse (status PENDING). Captures staffLeaveId.
Permission STAFF_LEAVE_READ. status required: PENDING|APPROVED|REJECTED|CANCELLED. Returns 200 Page<StaffLeaveResponse>.
Permission STAFF_LEAVE_REVIEW. Only PENDING requests. Returns 200 StaffLeaveResponse.
Permission STAFF_LEAVE_REVIEW. Only PENDING requests. Returns 200 StaffLeaveResponse.
Permission STAFF_LEAVE_CANCEL. Only PENDING requests. Returns 200 StaffLeaveResponse.
Permission STAFF_LEAVE_AUDIT_READ. Returns 200 List<StaffLeaveAuditResponse>.

Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_CREATE. leaveTypeId must be an existing leave_type id (not API-exposed). Student must have an active enrollment. Returns 201 StudentLeaveResponse (status PENDING). Captures studentLeaveId.
Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_READ. Returns 200 Page<StudentLeaveResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_REVIEW. Returns 200 StudentLeaveResponse.
Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_REVIEW. Returns 200 StudentLeaveResponse.
Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_CANCEL. Returns 200 StudentLeaveResponse.
Permission STUDENT_LEAVE_AUDIT_READ. Returns 200 List<StudentLeaveAuditResponse>.

Permission DISCIPLINE_INCIDENT_CREATE. category: BULLYING|PHYSICAL_AGGRESSION|DISRUPTION|DISRESPECT|ACADEMIC_DISHONESTY|PROPERTY_DAMAGE|ATTENDANCE|OTHER. severity: MINOR|MODERATE|MAJOR. incidentDate must be past/present. Returns 201 DisciplineIncidentResponse (status OPEN). Captures incidentId.
Permission DISCIPLINE_INCIDENT_READ. Optional campusId/status/severity/fromDate/toDate. Returns 200 Page<DisciplineIncidentResponse>.
Permission DISCIPLINE_INCIDENT_READ. Returns 200 DisciplineIncidentResponse.
Permission DISCIPLINE_INCIDENT_UPDATE. OPEN -> UNDER_REVIEW|RESOLVED|CLOSED; UNDER_REVIEW -> RESOLVED|CLOSED; RESOLVED -> CLOSED. Returns 200 DisciplineIncidentResponse.
Permission CALENDAR_EVENT_CREATE. eventType: HOLIDAY|EXAM|MEETING|SPORTS|CULTURAL|OTHER. Returns 201 CalendarEventResponse. Captures calendarEventId.
Permission CALENDAR_EVENT_READ. Optional campusId/fromDate/toDate. Returns 200 Page<CalendarEventResponse>.
Permission CALENDAR_EVENT_READ. Returns 200 CalendarEventResponse.
Permission CALENDAR_EVENT_UPDATE. Returns 200 CalendarEventResponse.
Permission CALENDAR_EVENT_DEACTIVATE. Returns 200 CalendarEventResponse with active=false.
Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_CREATE. applicantDateOfBirth must be in the past. Returns 201 AdmissionApplicationResponse (status APPLIED). Captures applicationId.
Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_READ. Optional campusId/status/fromDate/toDate. Returns 200 Page<AdmissionApplicationResponse>.
Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_READ. Returns 200 AdmissionApplicationSummaryResponse {appliedCount, underReviewCount, acceptedCount, rejectedCount, waitlistedCount, enrolledCount}.
Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_READ. Returns 200 AdmissionApplicationResponse.
Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_UPDATE. Editable only while APPLIED/UNDER_REVIEW. Returns 200 AdmissionApplicationResponse.

Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_UPDATE. APPLIED -> UNDER_REVIEW|ACCEPTED|REJECTED|WAITLISTED; UNDER_REVIEW -> ACCEPTED|REJECTED|WAITLISTED; WAITLISTED -> ACCEPTED|REJECTED. Returns 200 AdmissionApplicationResponse.

Permission ADMISSION_APPLICATION_ENROLL. Application must be ACCEPTED (transition it to ACCEPTED first). Creates a student and returns 200 AdmissionApplicationResponse (status ENROLLED, enrolledStudentId set).
Permission HOSTEL_CREATE. hostelType: BOYS|GIRLS|CO_ED. Returns 201 HostelResponse. Captures hostelId.
Permission HOSTEL_READ. Optional campusId/active. Returns 200 Page<HostelResponse>.
Permission HOSTEL_READ. Returns 200 HostelResponse.
Permission HOSTEL_UPDATE. version required. Returns 200 HostelResponse; 409 on stale version.
Permission HOSTEL_ROOM_CREATE. roomType: SINGLE|DOUBLE|TRIPLE|DORMITORY. Returns 201 HostelRoomResponse. Captures hostelRoomId.
Permission HOSTEL_ROOM_READ. Optional roomType/active. Returns 200 Page<HostelRoomResponse>.
Permission HOSTEL_ROOM_READ. Returns 200 HostelRoomResponse.
Permission HOSTEL_ROOM_UPDATE. Pessimistic lock; version required. Returns 200 HostelRoomResponse.

Permission HOSTEL_ALLOCATION_CREATE. Student must be active and have no other ACTIVE allocation; room must not be at capacity. Returns 201 HostelAllocationResponse (status ACTIVE). Captures allocationId.
Permission HOSTEL_ALLOCATION_READ. Optional roomId/studentId/status. Returns 200 Page<HostelAllocationResponse>.
Permission HOSTEL_ALLOCATION_READ. Returns 200 HostelAllocationResponse.
Permission HOSTEL_ALLOCATION_UPDATE. Only ACTIVE allocations; version required. Returns 200 HostelAllocationResponse (status VACATED).
Permission HOSTEL_ROOM_UPDATE. Returns 200 HostelRoomResponse with active=false.
Permission HOSTEL_UPDATE. Blocked (422) while active allocations exist. Returns 200 HostelResponse with active=false.

Permission INVENTORY_ITEM_CREATE. category: STATIONERY|FOOD|CLEANING|UNIFORM|EQUIPMENT|MEDICAL|OTHER. unit: PIECE|KG|GRAM|LITRE|MILLILITRE|PACKET|BOX|DOZEN. Returns 201 InventoryItemResponse. Captures itemId.
Permission INVENTORY_ITEM_READ. Optional campusId/category/active. Returns 200 Page<InventoryItemResponse>.
Permission INVENTORY_ITEM_READ. Returns 200 InventoryItemResponse.
Permission INVENTORY_ITEM_UPDATE. version required. Returns 200 InventoryItemResponse; 409 on stale version.
Permission INVENTORY_STOCK_RECEIVE. IN movement. quantity > 0 (11.3 digits). Returns 200 InventoryStockMovementResponse with balanceAfter.
Permission INVENTORY_STOCK_ISSUE. OUT movement; 422 if insufficient stock. Returns 200 InventoryStockMovementResponse.
Permission INVENTORY_STOCK_ISSUE. OUT movement. Returns 200 InventoryStockMovementResponse.
Permission INVENTORY_STOCK_ADJUST. direction: IN|OUT. Returns 200 InventoryStockMovementResponse.
Permission INVENTORY_STOCK_READ. Optional movementType RECEIPT|ISSUE|WASTAGE|ADJUSTMENT. Returns 200 Page<InventoryStockMovementResponse>.
Permission INVENTORY_ITEM_UPDATE. Blocked (422) while quantityOnHand > 0. Returns 200 InventoryItemResponse with active=false.

Requires BOTH MESS_MEAL_CREATE and INVENTORY_STOCK_ISSUE. mealType: BREAKFAST|LUNCH|SNACK|DINNER. servedOn past/present. 1..100 consumption lines. Issues stock via the inventory ledger. Returns 201 MessMealResponse. Captures mealId.
Permission MESS_MEAL_READ. Optional campusId/fromDate/toDate. Returns 200 Page<MessMealSummaryResponse>.
Permission MESS_MEAL_READ. Returns 200 MessMealResponse with consumption lines.
Authenticated (no permission). User-scoped. Returns 200 {unreadCount}.
Authenticated (no permission). Optional type filter. Returns 200 Page<NotificationResponse>. Captures notificationId from the first row if present.
Authenticated (no permission). Ownership-checked; 404 if not found or not owned. Returns 200 {notificationId, status:'READ'}.
Authenticated (no permission). Returns 200 {status:'SUCCESS', updatedCount}.
Permission NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX_READ (platform). Returns 200 Page<NotificationOutboxFailureResponse>. Captures outboxEventId from the first row if present.
Permission NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX_RETRY (platform). Returns 200 {eventId, status:'PENDING', message}. 404 if the event does not exist.
Permission NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX_READ (platform). Returns 200 NotificationOutboxSummaryResponse {pending, processing, delivered, dead, total}.

Permission DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_CREATE. The template body may contain the placeholders {{student_name}}, {{student_id}}, {{admission_number}}, {{institution_name}}, {{issue_date}}. Returns 201 DocumentTemplateResponse. Captures templateId. NOTE: the body below uses the literal brace tokens; if your Postman build substitutes unknown variables, retype them as needed.

body.raw: {"institutionId": "{{institutionId}}", "code": "BONAFIDE", "name": "Bonafide Certificate", "body": "This certifies that the named student is currently enrolled. Supported placeholders at issue time: {{student_name}}, {{student_id}}, {{admission_number}}, {{institution_name}}, {{issue_date}}."}

request.description: Permission DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_READ. Returns 200 List<DocumentTemplateResponse>.
Permission DOCUMENT_ISSUE. Renders the template for an active student and stores the text. Returns 201 IssuedDocumentResponse. Captures documentId.
Permission DOCUMENT_READ. Returns 200 IssuedDocumentResponse.
Permission DOCUMENT_READ. Returns 200 List<IssuedDocumentResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Self-scoped. Returns 200 List<IssuedDocumentResponse>.

Permission ANALYTICS_READ (institution scope). Date range <= 366 days, else 422. Returns 200 AnalyticsInstitutionSummaryResponse {institutionId, fromDate, toDate, activeStudents, activeStaff, activeEnrollments, attendancePresent, attendanceAbsent, attendanceLate, attendanceExcused, attendanceEligible, attendancePercentage}.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Self-scoped; resolves the student from the account link. Use a token for a user linked to a student. Returns 200 StudentResponse.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 List<ParentLessonAttendanceItemResponse>.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 ParentLessonAttendanceSummaryResponse.
Permission STUDENT_PORTAL_READ. Returns 200 List<AttendanceAlertResponse>.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ (class level). Use a token for a guardian account. Returns 200 List<ParentPortalStudentResponse>.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ + active guardian relationship with the student. Returns 200 ParentPortalStudentResponse; 403 if not linked.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ + guardian relationship. Returns 200 List<ParentAttendanceResponse>.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ + guardian relationship. Returns 200 List<ParentLessonAttendanceItemResponse>.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ + guardian relationship. Returns 200 ParentLessonAttendanceSummaryResponse.
Permission PARENT_PORTAL_READ + guardian relationship. Returns 200 List<AttendanceAlertResponse>.
Expected 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (generic message). Five failures in 15 minutes lock the username for 15 minutes (429).
Expected 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (Bean Validation on LoginRequest).
Expected 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Requires an authenticated admin token.
No Authorization header. Expected 401 returned by the security filter chain (Servlet default body, not ErrorResponse).
Missing required firstName (and lastName). Expected 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Run this with a token for a user WITHOUT PERMISSION_READ to see 403 ACCESS_DENIED. With the admin token it returns 200. The assertion accepts either.
